facts.fact: Huawei Cloud launched its first availability zone in South Africa (Johannesburg region) in November 2018 or early 2019, which the document describes as the first international cloud provider with a hyperscale data centre in Africa; as_of is the document's commitment/start year 2019 as the opening date is given only as 2018/2019.

Huawei Cloud launched a third availability zone in Johannesburg in January 2023, after investing over ZAR 3.5 billion in South African cloud infrastructure in 2019-2022, per Huawei Cloud's regional president.

Huawei Cloud operates ultra-large cloud data centres in Johannesburg (three availability zones by January 2023) selling IaaS, PaaS and SaaS to public-sector, financial, telecom and SME customers; first zone launched 2018/2019.
